  Problem: State load / candidate parse failures emit structured JSON with a full Python traceback in the "detail" field; _runtime_blocker_dispatch_eligible truncates it but still logs the traceback string into orchestrator comments/Telegram. The shell wrapper fails-open on any non-zero exit from the Python script, yet the structured error path returns rc=0.
  Why it fails at runtime: Transient JSON corruption, permission error on STATE_FILE, or malformed candidate_details_json produces noisy traceback in production logs and tracking-issue comments, violating operational hygiene and making triage harder; no clean separation between "expected legacy" errors and true infrastructure faults.
